decision_rule: Written 2026-11-14 before judging. An arm is recommended as an English repair pass if, on the flagged pages (en_only + both pooled), its judged serious defects (misleads + wrong_text) per 1,000 words are at least one third below stored (A), with the by-book 95% interval of the difference excluding 0, AND on CLEAN pages it adds no more than 0.5 serious defects per 1,000 words over A (upper by-book bound). Why: flagged pages are ~31% of served pages (421/1,344); a one-third cut on them is about 0.3/1k across all pages, so a pass run on every page must not add more than that on the ~69% that are clean. Sizing: A's audit rate on flagged pages is ~2.7-3.3 serious per 1k (~1.3 per page at ~420 words); a one-third cut is ~0.45 defects a page; with a per-page SD of the paired difference ~1.2 that needs ~60 pages per comparison (alpha 0.05, power 0.8) — 100 pooled flagged pages, 50 per group (each group alone shows a ~45% cut). CLEAN: +0.5/1k is ~0.17 defects a page at ~350 words; with SD ~0.6 that needs ~100 pages. Set: 50 en_only, 50 both, 100 clean.
